written_by_hand: This run was made on a rented instance that holds no copy of the repository, so record_run.py could not record it. The manifest is assembled from what the node returned; node.json is the scorer's own account of its environment and its cells, and score.log is the slice of the node's console log that belongs to this job.

bundle_check.how: The hashes the scorer recorded in node.json for the bundle it read, equal to bundle.json of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle. The scorer refuses a bundle whose hashes differ from bundle.json, so the node scored the recorded rows.

parts_check: 4 part files under parts/, one per (model, context seed, cell), equal to the 4 cell records of node.json; the parts concatenated are scores.parquet and reference.parquet row for row and probability for probability.

row_check.scored: 60,000 rows over 3 cohorts (2015Q3 to 2016Q1); every (cohort, row) pair, its outcome and its age match the gbm rows of experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-scores/scores.parquet, zero mismatches, no missing probability
row_check.reference: 50,000 rows; every row and its outcome match the gbm-50k reference of context seed 20260911 in experiments/2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-scores/reference.parquet, zero mismatches

console_log: score.log is the node's console output for this job: the scorer's own per-cell summary, the repeat check and the totals. It was read in full and holds no home path beyond /home/node/outoftime-node, no account name and no token; the TabICL checkpoint was downloaded from Hugging Face during this job (lines 27 to 30 of the index's score.log).
question_this_run_was_sent_to_answer: The one-hour device timing probe EXP-005 names before any Freddie Mac model is scored ("The accelerator, and the rule that sizes the grid", docs/experiments/EXP-005-tfm-out-of-time-second-book.md): seconds per scored row including context set-up for TabPFN and TabICL on a rented CUDA device, on the Lending Club 2015H1-E bundle at a 50,000-row context, at both softmax temperatures, so scripts/fm_grid_budget.py can size the Freddie Mac grid's wall time before it runs. Scored on the same rows and context seed as the LC grid's other recordings of this build, so the reading also carries the device term against the Apple GPU and the Tesla T4.

what_it_measured.model: tabicl, library tabicl 2.1.1; checkpoint(s) present on the node: tabicl-classifier-v2-20260212.ckpt (sha256 bdc7dbd5...), tabpfn-v3-classifier-v3_default.ckpt (sha256 d0d865d5...)
what_it_measured.context: 50,000 rows, context seed 20260911; softmax_temperature 0.9, n_estimators 8, random_state 42, average_logits true, categorical columns passed as object dtype
what_it_measured.chunk: 20,000 scored rows per forward call (--chunk 20000); the 50,000-row reference cell ran in three calls; rows are scored independently and the chunking changes no probability
what_it_measured.repeat: 2015Q3 scored twice from a fresh fit: largest absolute disagreement 0.0, no row differs; the second pass is the repeat check and its own seconds are not recorded separately in node.json, only the probability agreement.

timing_caveat: This is a measurement, not a caveated reading: the rented instance was idle and dedicated to this run (four probe jobs, then the twelve Freddie Mac jobs, back to back, no other process). Per-cell seconds and wall_seconds in node.json stand as recorded.
tuning_budget: Zero trials, no validation split, every parameter at the library default except those the command names. The classical models this pairs with were tuned on their own pool (build.json of the build's score run); the asymmetry runs both ways, since the 50,000-row control inherits the point chosen on the full pool.
not_in_this_run: The other three jobs of this probe: tabpfn@2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle, tabpfn-t1@2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle, tabicl-t1@2026-09-05-lc-2015h1e-bundle. The Freddie Mac falsifying run this probe was timed ahead of is experiments/2026-09-13-fm-2004h2e-rental-4090.
